subject: Re: CloudScape — Dedicated reserved capacity pricing & credits
messages:
From: Taylor Nguyen <procurement@cloudscape.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated GPU pool pricing + migration credit request

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. CloudScape is preparing a migration from our in-house stack to a hosted dedicated solution and we're gathering price/commit options. High level:
- Target steady-state throughput: ~2,000 tokens/sec sustained for 100 concurrent chat sessions (latency target sub-150ms p50)
- Expected baseline usage: 48 GPU-months per month (estimate based on current throughput)
- Desired term: 12 months reserved commit with burst capacity for peak loads

We've received a competing offer from OrbitAI that includes a 20% list discount + 3 months free credits for migration. To move forward with Redwood we'd need a competitive package: written throughput guarantee, a migration credit (or equivalent onboarding support), and clarity on rollback/fallback during upgrades.

Can you share a proposed committed pricing sheet and whether Redwood can match the competitor credits? Attaching our RFP for context.

Attachments: CloudScape-RFP-Q2.pdf (3 pages)

Best,
Taylor Nguyen
Head of Procurement
CloudScape Solutions
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <procurement@cloudscape.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool pricing + migration credit request

Taylor — thanks for sending this over and for the context. I appreciate the competitor price callout.

Looping in Marissa (your AE) and Ben (sales lead) to put together a committed offering, and Markus for the throughput/SLA side. We'll put together a short term-sheet and a proposal for a 12-month reserved commit plus options for burst credits during cutover.

Suggested next step: 30-min call tomorrow to walk the RFP and confirm workload characteristics so we size the pool correctly. What time window works for you?

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <procurement@cloudscape.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-13T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool pricing + migration credit request — initial proposal

Taylor — good to meet yesterday. Attached is an initial commercial proposal and a proposed commitment profile. High level:
- Committed: 48 GPU-months/month (preferred split: 4 x 12-GPU pools on A100-class instances)
- 12-month term
- Price: list less 15% (applies to compute unit price), plus $50,000 one-time onboarding credit (applied to first invoice)
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for reserved pools; throughput guarantee: p50 under target for steady-state based on profiling (pending Markus sign-off)
- Burst capacity: automatic burst pool available (pay-as-you-go pricing) for peak days

Attachment: proposal-cloudscape-v1.pdf

If OrbitAI is quoting 20% + 3 months free credits, we can consider an additional concession in the form of an extra credit or short-term price match, but anything beyond 15% will need director-level approval. Ben — can you confirm permissible concession range? Markus — can you confirm throughput guarantee assumptions on the sizing above?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@cloudscape.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Taylor Nguyen <procurement@cloudscape.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Dedicated GPU pool pricing + migration credit request — counter

Marissa/Vanessa —

Appreciate the quick turn. A few clarifications from procurement and finance:
- CloudScape is asking for a 22% discount off list OR 20% + 3 months migration credit (we're flexible on structure, prefer credits to be off invoice).
- We need a written throughput guarantee for 2,000 tokens/sec across the committed pools and a documented rollback policy for version upgrades that impact latency.
- Deal needs to be signed and billing ramped in Q3; procurement prefers the migration credit to be applied as bill credits over the first 3 invoices.

If Redwood can provide the throughput guarantee + matching the OrbitAI credit structure, we can move to a 2-week signature cadence.

Regards,
Alicia Park
Senior Procurement Manager
CloudScape Solutions
Attachments: comp-offer-orbitai.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-15T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal — concession path and next steps

Marissa/Vanessa — quick internal note before I reply to CloudScape.
- We can comfortably offer 15% + $50k onboarding credit under current playbook. Anything beyond 15% discount (or an additional 3 months of bill credits) requires director approval (Aditya).
- Markus: can you confirm we can provide a \"throughput guarantee\" for the 48 GPU-month profile (2k tokens/sec for 100 concurrent sessions)? If there are qualification steps or a preproduction test we should require, call them out so procurement knows how we verify.

I'll prepare a short executive ask if we want to escalate.

Ben
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-15T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal — concession path and next steps (technical note)

Ben/Marissa/Vanessa —

Short answer: yes, we can meet the 2k tokens/sec target on the proposed 4x12-GPU pools using A100-class instances with tuned batching and KV cache. Caveats and verification:
- We should require a 2-week pre-prod acceptance test run using a representative prompt set and traffic generator. Acceptance criteria: sustained 2k tokens/sec for 1 hour windows with p50 latency <150ms and p95 <350ms.
- SLA: for the committed configuration we can offer 99.9% availability for node-level uptime. Hard throughput guarantees are contingent on the acceptance test passing and a runbook that documents fallback to a burst pool if a pool is degraded.
- If CloudScape insists on a financial SLA for throughput (penalties), that's a finance/legal discussion; engineering can support measurable metrics and verifiable telemetry (traces, token throughput counters).

Recommendation: present the throughput guarantee as conditional on acceptance testing; offer 3 months of migration credits as one-time bill credit (preserves list price and makes margin-management easier).

-Markus
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — CloudScape competitive match (CS-2027-147)

Aditya —

As discussed, CloudScape (prospect) is asking us to match a competitive package (OrbitAI) that includes ~20% discount or 20%+3 months migration credit. Customer committed to a 12-month reserved profile (48 GPU-months/month) for mission-critical product infra.

We recommend the following concession package to win the account while protecting economics:
- Commercial ask: 20% off list OR 15% off list + 3 months migration bill credits (prefer credits)
- One-time onboarding credit: $40,000 (reduced from $50k in proposal)
- Condition: technical acceptance test (2 weeks) to validate throughput (2k tokens/sec) and baseline latency; throughput guarantee is contingent on acceptance results and runbook
- Contingency: require legal sign-off on SLA language; any financial penalty for missed throughput requires separate approval

Rationale: strategic account (multi-year expansion potential), competitor is providing credits; offering credits instead of deeper list discount preserves future flexibility. Bottom-line impact: at 20% list discount approximate ACV reduction vs proposal is X% (finance to confirm).

Request: executive approval to offer 20% discount OR the credit structure above; authority to sign if finance OK. We need a yes/no by 2027-07-20 to keep the 2-week signature cadence.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-25T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — CloudScape competitive match (CS-2027-147) — APPROVED (conditional)

Vanessa/Team —

Approve the credit-structured concession: offer 15% list discount + 3 months migration bill credits + $40k onboarding credit, conditional on finance sign-off and legal-approved SLA language. Do NOT move to a straight 20% list discount without further exec review.

Conditions to include in the outbound to CloudScape:
- Throughput guarantee tied to acceptance testing (2-week run) and observable telemetry
- Migration credits applied as bill credits across first 3 invoices (per procurement ask)
- DocuSign signature required with addendum language around acceptance test and rollback/runbook

Marissa — please finalize terms, generate the addendum and send for signature. Include the DocuSign link when you share the updated commercial.

Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
